tasks.command: python scripts/fetch_sources.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/detect_changes.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/extract_text.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/extract_envelope.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/diff_rules.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/generate_tests.py --config-id ${input:configId} && python scripts/create_pr.py --config-id ${input:configId}
